messages:
Maria (CS): Heads up — ChauffeurCorp drop: API calls and seat activity down ~60% over 14d. Procurement contact swapped to Raj Patel this week; CTO mentioned they're running a perf pilot with VectorLabs. Looks like a renewal at-risk signal. Can we triage?

AJ (Solutions): on it. Quick check: any webhook/auth errors showing up? looping in @Oliver for logs.

Oliver (Eng): spotted a burst of 4xx/429s for org_id 98765 on 2025-03-20. Proxy excerpts: 
```
{"org_id":"98765","status":"400","path":"/v1/generate","error":"invalid-api-key"}
{"org_id":"98765","status":"429","path":"/v1/embeddings","error":"rate_limit"}
```
invalid-api-key explains sudden traffic collapse — likely key rotation on their side.

Devon (Sales): Renewal in ~45 days (annual). If they're testing VectorLabs, need to move fast: (A) restore service ASAP (tech fix), (B) offer a short perf proof/boost to stall vendor momentum. I'll prep commercial language.

Maria (CS): Immediate playbook:
- Outreach: quick async note + offer 30-min triage call today (AJ + Oliver).
- Tech: verify API key, SDK version, and run sample request; Oliver to provide repro steps & ETA.
- Commercial: propose a 2-week complimentary dedicated throughput burst; Devon to draft PO.
- Exec: schedule short QBR + demo for CTO (smart routing/fallbacks). I'll own scheduling.

AJ (Solutions): Drafting message to Raj with checklist: confirm API key env matches dashboard, ensure SDK >=1.4.2, run sample request and paste response.

Integrations Bot: New ticket CH-1129 created — "ChauffeurCorp integration failure: invalid-api-key" https://support.redwood/ch/1129

Maria (CS): I'll tag CRM reasons: ["seat_activity_drop","procurement_change","competitive_evaluation"] and mark renewal flag: at-risk until QBR complete.

Devon (Sales): Can someone attach 6mo usage snapshot (tokens & seats)? I'll assemble mitigation + trial terms for Legal.

Maria (CS): Snapshot: https://redwood.screenshots/cc_usage_6m.png

Oliver (Eng): I can rotate their API key and send step-by-step fix. ETA ~30m.

AJ (Solutions): Scheduled 45m troubleshooting call with Raj + Eng Manager. I'll attach runbook and post-call test script.

Devon (Sales): Draft trial terms: "2-week dedicated burst, SLA 99.9%, complimentary". Routing to Legal for quick sign-off.

Maria (CS): Action owners noted. Please update this thread when CH-1129 is resolved and when QBR is booked. I'll create an exec summary for CS leadership. :white_check_mark:
